patches.summary: Added Exact Online Activities resource discovery and compound read workflows.
patches.reason: The user requested all commands plus out-of-the-box workflows for Activities; generated endpoint wrappers alone did not include cross-resource Activities overviews or docs/resource discovery.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... passes; activities resources/docs/overview/open-items/by-account appear in help; resources/docs commands return JSON.

patches.summary: Removed unused generated extractResponseData helper after polish/dogfood flagged it as dead code.
patches.reason: printing-press polish restored the helper because RootCmd was a false-positive dependency; a direct usage search showed extractResponseData was genuinely unused.
patches.validated_outcome: go test ./... and printing-press dogfood pass without dead-function warnings.

patches.summary: Migrated preserved activities_workflows.go to pp 4.31.1 signatures (c.Get with ctx; classifyAPIError with writer).
patches.reason: pp 4.31.1 changed Client.Get to (ctx,path,params) and classifyAPIError to (w,err,flags); regen --force preserved the hand-written file which broke the build.
patches.validated_outcome: go build/test/vet green after 1 fix round.

patches.summary: Wired the 5 hand-written Activities workflow commands (resources, docs, overview, open-items, by-account) into the command tree via init()+registerNovelCommand hook; added required pp:data-source annotations (local for resources/docs, live for overview/open-items/by-account).
patches.reason: pp 4.31.1 regen rewired generated activities.go without the workflow subcommands, leaving the 5 constructors orphaned (zero call sites); dogfood flagged them as 5 unregistered commands and 'activities --help' lacked them despite the activities-workflows patch claiming otherwise.
patches.validated_outcome: go build/test/vet green; 'activities --help' lists all 5; 'activities resources --agent' returns JSON; dogfood unregistered-commands warning gone; scorecard Dead Code 3/5 -> 5/5.

patches.summary: Removed genuinely-dead hasChangedLocalFlags and collectionItemsForOutput from helpers.go (zero call sites incl. tests; pflag import still used elsewhere).
patches.reason: printing-press polish dry-run + dogfood flagged them as dead; direct usage search confirmed genuinely unused. Kept isDryRunResponseForClient (3 call sites) and polish-flagged framework wrappers (resolveRead*, resource*Path, decodeWriteThroughNonEmptyArray passed as func value) as evidenced false positives; kept maxAge flag as accepted WARN (generated root.go surface).
patches.validated_outcome: go build/test/vet green; dogfood dead functions 3 -> 1 (false positive only); binaries rebuilt.
